title: The Lucena position
line: Build a bridge with the rook, and the pawn promotes.

steps.text: This is the Lucena position. Your king stands in front of its pawn. If it steps out, Black's rook checks it again and again.
The way out is a bridge. Put your rook on the fourth row, so that later it can block the checks.
Build the bridge: move your rook up to the fourth row.
steps.after: Now the rook waits on the row where it will block.

steps.text: Step out from in front of the pawn, to its side.
steps.hint: Step to the file beside the pawn.

steps.text: Walk toward your rook, keeping the pawn guarded.
Keep walking down toward your rook, and keep the pawn guarded.

also.b6a6: That also walks down and keeps the pawn guarded. This lesson goes the other way.

wrong.b6c5: That leaves the pawn unguarded, and Black's rook takes it.

steps.hint: Step toward the rook while still touching the pawn.

steps.text: Step down once more, toward the fourth row.

also.c6d5: That works too, though the king must come back to guard the pawn. This lesson stays next to the pawn's file.

steps.hint: Step down to the fifth row, next to the pawn's file.
steps.after: Next check, the rook blocks it.

steps.text: Block the check with your rook. That is the bridge.
steps.hint: The rook slides across its row.
steps.after: No more checks. The pawn promotes.

summary: In the Lucena position, put the rook on the fourth row, walk the king out, and block the last check with the rook.
